test_case.test_name: NVIDIA nvbandwidth full single-node path matrix against platform SPEC
test_case.purpose: Run the official nvbandwidth suite over the approved NVIDIA GPU topology and validate host-device plus device-device PCIe/NVLink copy paths, directions and methods against matching SKU/topology specifications without substituting DCGM diagnostic status.
required_package: Pinned signed NVIDIA/nvbandwidth release or approved build hash, CUDA Toolkit and compatible NVIDIA driver
GPU SKU/serial/UUID/BDF/NUMA and NVLink/PCIe topology matrix
Approved testcases or explicit full-suite scope, buffer size, sample count, median/mean policy and affinity settings
Per-testcase/per-path/direction GB/s floors and tolerances mapped to topology and copy method
Thermal/power/XID/AER/link abort limits, cooling/OOB readiness and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Verify the pinned nvbandwidth binary with `nvbandwidth --version` and preserve `nvbandwidth --list`. Bind every GPU UUID to the recorded topology. Unless the project SPEC explicitly narrows coverage, run the official full suite as `nvbandwidth --format json` with the approved default-or-larger peak buffer, sample count and affinity; retain complete JSON and unfiltered stderr. If specific selectors are approved, list every `--testcase`/prefix and prove the resulting path matrix is complete. Compare each native metric with its matching path/direction/method threshold; never use `dcgmi diag -r 5` as a substitute.
test_case.expected_result: All required nvbandwidth testcases and topology paths execute successfully, report complete JSON identities and GB/s values, pass internal data verification, and meet their approved path-, direction-, method- and SKU-specific thresholds without new XID, AER, link, thermal or power faults.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact binary/stack and GPU topology identity, a coverage matrix proving every required native testcase/path ran, unfiltered JSON, correct per-direction interpretation and approved numeric thresholds. Output presence, grepped/tail text, DCGM PASS, a connectivity-size buffer or missing SPEC is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Validate the exact GPU UUID/topology and pinned CUDA-compatible tool before load
Use the default 512 MiB or project-approved peak buffer for performance; a small connectivity buffer cannot replace formal bandwidth coverage
Bound samples/runtime and stop on XID, AER, link degradation, thermal or power limits
Preserve full evidence and do not change clocks/power/link state or retry automatically
expected_evidence: nvbandwidth version/build hash, CUDA/driver versions and full `--list` output
GPU UUID/BDF/NUMA/NVLink/PCIe topology and required testcase/path matrix
Exact invocation, buffer/samples/statistic/affinity and complete JSON plus stderr/exit
Per-path GB/s values reconciled with correctly matched thresholds and bidirectional semantics
Thermal/power/XID/AER/link pre/during/post evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On CUDA/tool error, GPU loss, invalid verification, XID/AER, link degradation, thermal/power limit or hang, terminate the suite, preserve JSON/stderr/telemetry and return GPUs to the approved idle state. Use the platform recovery plan and never substitute DCGM or auto-retry.
